name: al-web-components
description: The Web Component powered design system for web applications

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run build:icons && npm run build:custom-elements.json && del-cli dist && vite build -c vite.config.mjs && tsc && node ../../scripts/copy-assets-to-dist.js
scripts.test:ci: concurrently -k -s first -n 'sb,test' -c 'magenta,blue' 'pnpm start --quiet' 'wait-on tcp:6006 && test-storybook --url http://localhost:6006'

//sideEffects: ALLOWLIST of paths that DO have side effects. Everything not listed is treated as side-effect-free and may be dropped when unused. Component and chunk modules MUST stay listed: they call customElements.define at module scope, and dropping that silently renders every <al-*> tag as an unknown element. Phosphor glyph data is emitted to dist/icon-glyphs/ (see chunkFileNames in vite.config.mjs) precisely so it can be omitted here — that omission is what lets a consumer importing 3 icons from glyphs.js avoid shipping all 1,512.
